snippet.title: Conquer Lands | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
▶️ Conquer Lands available now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906660/Conquer_Lands/?utm_medium=youtube_1&utm_campaign=general&utm_source=youtube

The kingdom's salvation depends on the slaughter of all the lords.

Conquer Lands is finally here! Conquer Lands is a roguelike card and strategy game where you build your own unique deck of cards and units to battle against challenging lords and claim your path to the throne.
